Signing
⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::cryp::
VerifierPublicCtx::Verify
shall implement the verification algorithm configured
for this context. The interface shall return
•
kUninitializedContext
, if
ara::crypto::cryp::VerifierPublic-
Ctx::SetKey
was not called before.
•
kInvalidInputSize
, if a supplied
ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRegion
parameter's size is incompatible with the configured signature algorithm.
